verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Plaid publishes an llms.txt at plaid.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), giving agents a direct entry point. The Identity Verification docs are also served as markdown via index.html.md URLs, which agents can ingest, though the bare /.md path returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt specifically covers the Identity Verification docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and a consistent .md path convention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://plaid.com/llms.txt # Plaid
